notes.title: Vampires are back and much improved just in time for Halloween!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Some time ago we've self-released our game called Vampires. To my surprise, we've been greenlit and since that moment we've worked hard to perfect the game for you and make it a proper Steam experience.

What's new?

1. Cloud saves
2. Steam Achievements
3. Global Leaderboards
4. Per-level leaderboards for the best players, bringing an extra layer of challenge
5. Streamlined some levels which were maybe too frustrating. 
6. Some visual assets improvement

Thank you everyone who believed in our game and enjoy!

Jan
